answer: In PoA, each bonded identity signs and remains slashable for equivocation; when k identities coordinate on conflicting histories, correlated evidence triggers an O(k^2) penalty through pairwise fault attribution and escrow burns. Detection of a sybil swarm also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, making duplicated stake economically self-defeating: attempts to forge consensus, pulse false support, or hide behind shale-like identities amplify rather than dilute risk.
